parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority may request the Central Government to furnish information or documents within seven days for making recommendations.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Central Government provides requested information within seven days.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when the Authority requests information for recommendations.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines a time-bound obligation for the Central Government to provide information.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government may issue a licence to a service provider if no recommendations are received from the Authority within the specified period.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government issues a licence when no recommendations are received within the time limit.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when the Authority fails to provide recommendations within the time limit.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the licensing authority of the Central Government in the absence of recommendations.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority may notify rates for telecommunication services in India and outside India in the Official Gazette.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Authority publishes rates for telecommunication services in the Official Gazette.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when the Authority sets rates for telecommunication services.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the Authority's power to set and notify service rates.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority shall not act against the sovereignty and integrity of India, the security of the State, or friendly relations while discharging its functions.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Authority's actions do not compromise sovereignty, security, or friendly relations.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when the Authority is performing its functions.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the restriction on the Authority's actions regarding national interests.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Authority shall require individuals to produce books of account or documents relating to an inquiry within the specified time.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=POWERS AND FUNCTIONS OF THE AUTHORITY
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if individuals provide required documents within the time specified by the Authority.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when the Authority conducts an inquiry.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the obligation to provide documents during an inquiry.

parsed_entries.requirement: The clause does not apply to matters relating to individual consumer complaints before consumer forums.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=Provided that nothing in this clause shall apply in respect of matters relating to
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the clause does not apply to consumer complaints before consumer forums.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when consumer complaints are made before consumer forums.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause excludes consumer complaints from its scope.

parsed_entries.requirement: The clause does not apply to disputes between telegraph authorities and other persons under the Indian Telegraph Act.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=Provided that nothing in this clause shall apply in respect of matters relating to
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the clause excludes disputes between telegraph authorities and other persons.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when disputes between telegraph authorities and other persons arise.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause excludes disputes under the Indian Telegraph Act from its scope.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government or other entities may apply to the Appellate Tribunal for dispute resolution or appeals.
parsed_entries.source: TRAI_ACT_1997, SECTION=Provided that nothing in this clause shall apply in respect of matters relating to
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government or other entities can apply to the Appellate Tribunal for dispute resolution.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when disputes are referred to the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.notes: This clause outlines the right of entities to apply to the Appellate Tribunal for dispute resolution.
